appDescription: Discover Egyptian mythology: the gods, the great cosmogonies and myths, and test your knowledge with a quiz.
instructions:
Answer the questions as fast as you can
You have 20 seconds to answer each question
You have 3 lives
For 5 good answers in a row, you earn one life, but only if you have lost one
The faster you answer, the more points you earn
exitMsg: Are you sure you want to leave the application?
quizFinishText: You have completed the quiz! You are an ace of Egyptian mythology.

godsShare: The deities were omnipresent in the daily life of the Egyptian people and they sought in these deities, support and protection against the forces of evil… Learn more about the Egyptian gods with this application: {value}
cosmogoniesShare:
Throughout history, Men have sought to explain, to imagine the origin of the world, the moment when Creation takes place and gives birth to Men, animals, plants, all living things, water, land, etc., the ancient Egyptians are no exception… 
 Learn more about Egyptian cosmogonies with this application: {value}
mythsShare:
Myths are intended to explain the origins of a belief and they take an important place in ancient Egyptian civilization because ancient Egyptians sought to interpret all the phenomena they could observe through the prism of beliefs… 
 Learn more about the main Egyptian myths with this application: {value}
